space.$description: Space between and around things, on a 4px grid with 2px for hairline gaps. 1px is 1dp on Android and 1pt on Apple platforms.

xxs.$description: Between a line of text and the line under it in the same item.

xs.$description: Between lines of one item; around small things.

sm.$description: Between an icon and its text; between buttons, chips and lines in a card.

md.$description: Between cards and sections; inside choice cards.

lg.$description: A page's side margins; inside cards; between a tile and its text.

xl.$description: Around a page that stands alone, such as pairing.

xxl.$description: Side margins of a centred message.

xxxl.$description: Above and below a centred message or a wait.
